fields.label: Deployment Mode
fields.options:
Single server (website and ERP together)
Website server (ERP hosted separately)
ERP server (website hosted separately)
fields.description: How the public website and the ERP are hosted. The PCPB Website app is installed on each server and this setting says which part that server plays.

fields.label: Deployment Help
fields.options:
Single server: one site runs the website and the ERP; nothing else to set.
Website server: this site shows the public website and reads registers, services and vacancies from the ERP through its API.
ERP server: this site holds the records and answers the website's API requests; it shows no public website.

fields.label: ERP Address
fields.description: Base address of the ERP site, for example https://erp.pcpb.go.ke

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: From the integration user on the ERP: User > Settings > API Access

fields.label: Cache Duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long an ERP answer is reused before the ERP is asked again. 0 turns caching off.

fields.label: API Access Help
fields.options: The website server signs in to this ERP with a standard API key. Create the integration user here, then copy its API Key and API Secret into Integration Settings on the website server. The user has one role, PCPB Website Integration, which gives it nothing beyond the public register, service and vacancy data.

fields.label: Create Integration User and API Keys
Portals Help
fields.options: Each portal the public is sent to. Leave the address empty when a portal is on the ERP site (or on this site when everything is on one server). Sign in, Create an account and Apply use the portal whose audience is Customers and applicants. Tender pages offer the Suppliers portal.
